learning_outcomes.text: Extension of knowledge and acquisition of basic skills at design of machine parts and mechanisms.
Clarification of basic calculating theories, models, procedures and design principles of machine elements and assembly units with general use.
Practical design solutions of simple design tasks, including elaboration of preliminary design, check calculations and assembly drawings.

syllabus_topics: Basic principles of supporting systems design.
Bolt and screw joints. Geometry, mechanics and design of thread pairs.
Bolt and screw connections - theory and design of preloaded joints.
Design of preloaded bolts and screws at variable external load. Motion screws and nuts.
Removable joints of shafts and hubs - clamped, pressed, splined, keyed.
Joints with clevis pins, pins, shrunk-on rings. Design of welded joints.
Butt and fillet welds - practical design calculations. Bonded and riveted joints.
Mechanical transmissions - kinematic and dynamic behaviour, calculating models.
Design of belt and chain drives, transmissions with friction wheels.
Geared transmissions - types, basic law of gearing, theory of involute gearing.
Spur gear drives - dimensional and strength calculations, design, measuring, production.
Helical gear drives - virtual gear theory, rules of calculating methods, dimensional and strength calculations, design, measuring, production.
Bevel gear drives - virtual and bivirtual gears theory, rules of calculating methods.
Hypoid gear drives. Screw and worm gear drives - dimensional and strength calculations, design and production of gears.
teaching_methods: Seminars devoted to practical individual solution of simple design projects
Sketching of machine elements and their simple assembly units

assessment_methods.method: elaboration and successful defence (respecting due dates) of all assigned design tasks
elaboration of given number of sketched machine elements and their assembly units
examination of knowledge of whole range of lectured subject matters
examination of sketching ability (model-less sketching of machine elements and their simple assembly units)
examination of numerical design calculation of assigned simple design tasks with use of technical literature
